gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histopathologically proven glioblastoma or brain metastasis and suspected tumor progress on standard MRI after first line therapy and who are candidates for elective surgical resection.

candidate_evidence.quote: An advanced diffusion weighted MRI-sequence will be performed in addition to the routine MRI-diagnostics.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: suspected tumor progress on standard MRI after first line therapy

coder_notes: Diagnostic imaging study (ADW-MRI), registered Phase NA; no drug or biologic intervention. Population is glioblastoma or brain metastasis; coded basket_gbm_eligible because brain metastases (multiple primary cancers) are also eligible; mixed_glioma_gbm_named would be the alternative, both include. Fails S3 (phase NA) and S6 regardless.
